title: Native reservation availability copy and Review
lede: Gear now names the person on a hold in reservation purple or checkout red. Review is a grouped form with a matchup-only title, and it no longer calls timing notices conflicts.

sections.heading: After-only fixture evidence
sections.note: iPhone 16 Pro (27.0) UDID E055DEBC-12B1-4E0F-BE11-1CFFF4A454DE, WisconsinPerformance create-booking-events, light appearance. The 7:43 AM device screenshots are live inventory in a different clock and appearance, so they are not a matched before pair.

shots.title: Gear holds
shots.cap: CAM-014 reads “Jordan Lee has reserved for today at 1:00 PM.” in purple and stays addable. LENS-032 reads “Erik Role has this item until today at 2:00 PM.” in red with a red alert in the add slot.

shots.title: Selected cart
shots.cap: Adding CAM-015 opens the Sony Battery card above the toolbar. The count stays visible at 0 on a system stepper. The cart is purple with a red badge.

shots.title: Review
shots.cap: The title is MBB vs Duke with Rivalry Night dropped. Schedule uses native labeled rows. There is no gear-conflict card for an addable selection.

changes.was: Conflict rows named the overlapping booking and window. Needed-next used clock-advisory language, often read as a conflict.
changes.now: Reserved holds name the person and start in purple. Active checkouts name the person and until-time in red.

changes.was: The selected cart could inherit a red tint. Battery and counted rows used custom plus/minus circles.
changes.now: The cart icon is reservation purple with a system red badge. Counted quantities use a system Stepper.

changes.was: The title kept promotion extras after the matchup. Schedule used colored icon circles. A conflict card counted every visible catalog hold, including items that were not selected.
changes.now: Review is a grouped form. The title is matchup-only. Schedule uses LabeledContent. A route back to Gear appears only when a selected item is actually blocked.

verification: vitest ios-create-booking-picker-parity, availability, ios-api-contract, and ios-native-control-cleanup passed (99 tests).
git diff --check passed on the touched composer, test, and area-doc files.
npx tsc --noEmit still reports unrelated UserScoreboardTab and blasts errors; availability.ts did not add new TypeScript failures.
notes: Authenticated physical dark-mode proof remains open.
